subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Mandy realized history was not only about rulers and battles.”?
options: It was also about people trying to live through difficult times.
People had sung it during marches, meetings, and difficult times.
It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
It is also about where people stopped.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Mandy realized history was not only about rulers and battles. It was also about people trying to live through difficult times.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「People had sung it during marches, meetings, and difficult times.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It is also about where people stopped.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Mandy realized history was not only about rulers and battles. It was also about people trying to live through difficult times.」，答案為「It was also about people trying to live through difficult times.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It was also about people trying to live through difficult times.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
